full_prompt_en: A square monochrome engraving shows an elderly bearded man in strict left-facing profile. The front of the head retains a realistic eye, nose, moustache and long curling beard. Behind the ear and through the crown, the skull is opened into a dense arrangement of gears, rods, pipes and tiny figures or carved mechanisms. A curved metal plate caps part of the forehead, while another broad metal collar frames the lower neck. The right side of the image is packed with mechanical detail; the left background is almost black, making the pale profile stand forward. Every surface is described by fine etched lines and crosshatching. Hair strands, metal ridges and small joints are painstakingly distinguished, yet the overall head remains a clear single silhouette. Light comes from the upper left, striking the forehead, bridge of the nose and metal edges, while cavities and gear recesses deepen to charcoal. The beard carries softer gray values than the hard machinery, creating a contrast between organic and engineered textures. The image feels like a historical anatomical plate transformed into a surreal invention. Its tight crop leaves little space for setting or action; the viewer is invited to inspect the impossible interior of one face. A restrained black, white and silver range gives the elaborate construction both precision and drama.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色版刻呈现一位长须老者严格朝左的侧面。头部前方保留写实的眼、鼻、髭须和长卷胡。耳后与头顶被打开，内部密集排列齿轮、杆、管道和细小人物或雕刻机构。一片弯曲金属板覆盖部分前额，另一片宽金属领围住颈下。图像右侧塞满机械细节；左侧背景几乎发黑，使浅色侧面突出。每个表面由细刻线与交叉排线描述。发丝、金属凸脊和小关节被费心区分，整个头仍保持清楚的单一剪影。光从左上来到，照亮额头、鼻梁与金属边缘，空腔和齿轮凹处加深至炭色。胡须的灰调比坚硬机构柔和，形成有机与工程纹理对比。图像像历史解剖图被转化为超现实发明。紧裁切几乎不留环境或动作空间，让观者细看一张面孔里不可能的内部。克制的黑白银色范围使复杂结构既精确又戏剧化。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome engraving depends on exceptionally fine contour lines, crosshatching and densely nested mechanical textures. Pale silver planes emerge from near-black recesses under directional upper light. Organic curls and rigid geometric ridges alternate, but a firm outer silhouette keeps the detail readable. Tight cropping removes most empty space, turning the composition into an intricate study of surfaces and cavities. The black, white and gray range feels precise, antique and uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色版刻依靠极细轮廓线、交叉排线与密集嵌套的机械纹理。浅银平面在上方定向光下从近黑凹处显出。有机卷线和僵直几何凸脊交替，但坚实外剪影使细节可读。紧裁切移去大部分空域，使构图成为表面与空腔的繁密习作。黑白灰色域精确、古旧而奇异。
theme_en: An engraved bearded profile with exposed mechanical anatomy
theme_zh: 头部机械结构外露的版刻胡须侧面像
name: Andreas Vesalius
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
